verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser ships a built-in AI agent layer (HyperAgent's `page.ai()` for natural-language task delegation like 'search flights and pick cheapest', plus `page.extract()` for natural-language structured extraction and a broader 'AI-driven browser agents' overview), letting users delegate browsing tasks to an in-product AI assistant via simple API calls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of task delegation quality and reliability, and more detail on multi-step agent orchestration beyond the quickstart examples.
